name: Ahmad Kamal
bio:
Ahmad Kamal's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly, fueled by a lifelong fascination with engineering and a chance encounter with a local racing team during his university days. Initially volunteering as a data analyst, his knack for optimizing performance through meticulous observation and strategic adjustments quickly became apparent. Over the years, he honed his skills across various disciplines, from vehicle dynamics to pit stop logistics, eventually transitioning into management roles. 

Now as Head of Operations at Blau Motorsport, Ahmad brings a holistic, systems-oriented approach to the team. He's known for his ability to identify bottlenecks and streamline processes, fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Ahmad's distinctive strength lies in his capacity to translate complex technical concepts into actionable strategies, bridging the gap between the engineering department and the racing crew.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ahmad has a warm smile and a quietly confident demeanor.
